_comment: Golden prompts (docs/2026-08-08_PRD_AssetFitnessAndReview.md Layer 2). A FIXED, SMALL set of child-shaped prompts run on demand against the real model, so a regression in generated output is caught before a child finds it. Kids never see these; nothing in the generation pipeline reads this file. Keep the set small and DIVERSE — a large set tempts tuning the prompt against a fixed target, which is how every kid's game starts looking the same. A prompt may carry an `edit` turn (2026-08-17): the harness then sends a SECOND real turn against the built game, which is where most faults are actually introduced — an edit gets the slimmed edit contract, and every bug found on 2026-08-17 entered on an edit, not a build.

prompts.text: 3D - make a race track with 4 corners and a start line
prompts.why: The 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-09 bugs both lived here: corner rotation, one kit at one scale, finish-line proportion.

prompts.text: 3D - make a city with roads and cars driving around
prompts.why: The OTHER road kit. City runs X, racing runs Z — the disagreement that caused the first fault.

edit.text: add lots of cars and bikes driving on the roads
edit.why: The owner's 'I have been asking the game for moving cars and bikes on the road but it didnot provide yet'. An edit that ADDS models is the case where the stripped USES_MODELS marker used to lose the game's own toy box (model-select.ts, 2026-08-17) and where loadModelBatch names never reached AR_ASSETS.

prompts.why: Animated/skinned models and named animation clips — a different subsystem from tiles.

prompts.text: make a simple catch the falling stars game
prompts.why: The 2D floor. Most games are 2D and must never be disturbed by 3D pipeline work.

prompts.text: 3D - make a skiing game down a snowy mountain with flags to go through
3D - make a jungle game with a crocodile and a monkey and an elephant
3D - make a rain forest game with a river and a crocodile
3D - make a race game with a long curvy track through a village
prompts.why: 2026-08-16, Village Turbo Racer: the build imported CatmullRomCurve3 (not exported by our bundle), the module failed to PARSE and the child's Start button did nothing. This is the prompt shape that produced it — roads-as-geometry plus 'curvy' is the exact invitation.

prompts.text: 3D - make a car racing game where I drive the blue car and the camera follows behind
prompts.why: 2026-08-15: the kart faced the camera and drove in reverse, and a later game put the camera so far back the car was a speck. Covers facing (car faces -Z), modelHeading for steering, and camera distance sized from the car.

edit.text: make it take off and land with buttons
edit.why: The Mumbai Flight Sim turn, exactly. It adds on-screen controls (the pointer-events + one-input-intent rules) and is the turn on which the player model was silently swapped for a spaceship.

prompts.text: 3D - make a driving game past a village with trees, houses, chickens and a lake
prompts.why: 2026-08-15: a 65-second recording showed an EMPTY world while Ari said it had added all of these — props sat 8-11 road-widths off the route and fog ended at 150. Covers the scenery-placement rules.

edit.text: add some tall buildings to the village
edit.why: A4: does the model USE the library's buildings, or hand-build 600 BoxGeometry blocks with painted-on windows? This is the owner's 'the skyscrapers have windows in the model why is it not coming through in the game?'.

prompts.text: make me a realistic car game with real looking cars
prompts.why: 2026-08-16: a child saying 'realistic' means 3D. Never says '3d', so it also proves THREE_INTENT_RE unlocks the catalog — if it comes back a 2D canvas game, the gate regressed.

prompts.text: make a shooting game with soldiers and guns and bullets
prompts.why: 2026-08-16 owner decision: guns and bullets are welcome. Proves both the persona clause AND the input safety classifier, which used to carve out only CARTOON action and could block this before the model ever saw it.

prompts.text: 3D - make a farm game with a tractor, animals and a barn I can drive around
prompts.why: Exercises placeModel/modelHeading/modelMetres end to end — including the 2026-08-15 gate bug where a game using only placeModel got NO helper injected and died on 'placeModel is not defined'. Also hits the invented-name resolver (a barn is not in the library).
